minutes.headline: PACC voted by roll call, 3 yes, to ask Town Meeting to fully fund its FY27 PEG access budget from retained earnings.
minutes.summary: A special meeting of the Public Access Cable Committee, held by Zoom on short notice, took up one item: warrant wording for an FY27 budget increase. Members reworded the article to say "fully fund" rather than "fund" so it would not suggest the original budget was wrong. A motion with the summary of the salary increase was seconded and approved by roll call, and the meeting adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Public Access Cable Committee voted 3-0 by roll call to ask Town Meeting to fully fund the FY27 PEG access operating budget from retained earnings.
Members changed the article's wording from "fund" to "fully fund" so it would not imply the original budget was wrong.
The article's summary describes a salary increase for the rest of FY27, with indirect costs rising alongside it and included in the request.
The chair will assemble the final wording and forward it to the select board's office as required for a duly called meeting.

why_it_matters: The request would draw on the PEG access enterprise fund's retained earnings rather than the tax levy, so it is a spending decision Town Meeting voters would be asked to approve.
The minutes do not state the amount, so residents cannot yet judge the size of the salary increase or how much retained earnings it would use.
